title: Getting Started with Next.js
excerpt: Learn the basics of building modern web applications with Next.js.
content: Next.js is a React framework for building fast and scalable web applications. It provides routing, server rendering, static generation, and many other useful features.
author: Haresh

title: Understanding Static Generation
excerpt: A simple explanation of Static Site Generation in Next.js.
content: Static Site Generation means generating HTML pages at build time. These pages can then be served quickly from a CDN without generating the page for every request.
author: Haresh

title: Dynamic Routes in Next.js
excerpt: Learn how dynamic routes work using the App Router.
content: Dynamic routes allow us to create pages based on changing values such as a post slug. In Next.js, folders like [slug] are used to create dynamic routes.
author: Haresh
